units.source_text: 织布商宗助比批发商佐田太吉郎小四五岁，他们之间撇开买卖不说，确是志趣相投。

en.t: The weaver Sosuke was four or five years younger than the wholesaler Sada Takichiro, and apart from business, the two of them were truly kindred spirits.

units.source_text: 年轻时还算是“老哥儿们”。

en.t: When they were young, they could still be called old friends.

units.source_text: 但是近来多少有些疏远了。

en.t: But lately they had grown somewhat distant.
